messages:
Elena - Partnerships: Heads up 1: we need to lock the SI certification window and a rehearsal slot for the public co-announcement. Can we coordinate timelines?
Tom - SI Programs: Proposed dates: cert window opens 2026-04-20, closes 2026-05-03. Rehearsal week for partners: 2026-04-13 to 04-17. Thoughts?
Priya - Certifications: 04-20 works for the exam launch, but we need a 72h buffer to finalize proctor list and voucher codes. That pushes publishing assets to 04-17 EOD.
Jake - Labs Ops: For hands-on lab access, we can seed 50 demo seats per SI in our sandbox cluster. Need names + emails by 04-10 to provision. Also confirming hardware kiosk images will be ready by 04-14.
Hannah - Marketing: Co-announcement slot: 04-22 preferred for press alignment. We can do a soft partner email the same week. If cert goes live 04-20, that gives 48h breathing room.
Elena - Partnerships: Alignment note: partners expect a practice test & study guide at least one week before cert. Can we commit to a practice exam by 04-13?
Priya - Certifications: We can ship a practice exam (non-graded) by 04-13 if training content is frozen by 04-06. Otherwise we'll do a beta practice on 04-15. Recommend freeze 04-06.
Tom - SI Programs: Freeze date accepted. I'll hammer stakeholders for content freeze 04-06. Also proposing a partner onboarding webinar on 04-14 (60 min) to walk through the exam blueprint and badge benefits.
Elena - Partnerships: +1 for webinar. Marketing, can you host and record?
Hannah - Marketing: Yes. I'll reserve Zoom + recording. Also need speaker list by 04-08. Can include a 10-min case study from 1 SI.
Jake - Labs Ops: Quick ops checklist draft for provisioning:
```
- collect SI roster CSV (name,email,org)
- map accounts to sandbox orgs
- pre-seed token quotas (10 seats default)
- upload kiosk images v1.3
- run smoke tests on eu-west, us-east
- confirm hardware access SLA (4h)
```
Priya - Certifications: Proctoring notes: we will use our proctor vendor (ExamGuard). Requirements: government IDs for listed exams; ~200 voucher codes reserved. Also need exam blueprint + passing score (propose 75%).
Tom - SI Programs: Passing score 75% seems fair. For recertification cadence propose annual. Also thinking about a "badge+reference architecture" pack for partners who pass with 90%+.
Elena - Partnerships: Love the high-performer pack idea. Marketing, can we create a "SI Spotlight" template for partner PR if they earn high-performer pack?
Hannah - Marketing: Yes, template ready by 04-16. We'll need partner logos and one liner.
Priya - Certifications: Logistics: cert-bot will generate list of voucher codes and expiry windows. cert-bot: allocate 200 vouchers for SI-launch (expiry 2026-06-30).
cert-bot: Vouchers allocated: 200 (ids masked). Expiry set to 2026-06-30.
Elena - Partnerships: Two more asks: 1) rehearsal checklist for co-announcement demo (who speaks, tech owner, fallback plan) and 2) approval path for partner logos in the announcement (legal + partner signoff).
Tom - SI Programs: I'll draft rehearsal runbook and host a dry-run 04-15. Runbook items: opening script, demo steps, Q&A owner, rollback script, contact list.
Jake - Labs Ops: Rehearsal environment: will be a no-network snapshot to avoid data drift. Bring a fallback video recording in case live demo fails.
Hannah - Marketing: I'll coordinate legal signoff loop and collect partner permission forms. Need forms back by 04-18 to be safe.
Elena - Partnerships: Summary actions: Tom=content freeze follow-up + rehearsal runbook, Priya=voucher + proctoring setup, Jake=lab seats + kiosk images, Hannah=announce assets + legal loop, Elena=partner coordination + dry-run scheduling. Aim to close these by 04-17.
Tom - SI Programs: Understood. I'll post a short tracker after today's sync.
Elena - Partnerships: Thanks team. If anything blocks the freeze date, flag here immediately. :calendar:
